map.reading:
Assessment summary. Verified quotations do not establish demand or purchase intent; commercial priority remains a hypothesis.
- Cost-sensitive ecommerce support team replacing Intercom/Zendesk: hypothesis; product compatibility unknown; audience evidence limited (2 quoted source(s)); use or purchase captured; reachability venue identified.
- Bootstrapped/early-stage SaaS team automating Tier-1 support: hypothesis; product compatibility supported; audience evidence absent (1 quoted source(s)); use or purchase unknown; reachability unknown.
- Omnichannel retail support team unifying customer history across channels: hypothesis; product compatibility supported; audience evidence limited (1 quoted source(s)); use or purchase unknown; reachability unknown.
map.note: Coverage gaps: no direct Reddit/forum buyer quotes were found despite searching; evidence for the retail/Decathlon segment rests on a single vendor-published testimonial with no independent corroboration; could not verify typical team size or ticket volume thresholds that make Crisp's paid tiers (Mini/Essentials/Plus) a fit versus staying on the free plan or choosing a competitor. Four queries were used per the research budget; a fifth query targeting Reddit/forum discussions directly (e.g. r/ecommerce, r/SaaS) could surface firsthand buyer voice not captured here.

Review before prioritising.

decision_gaps: Does Crisp publish a Shopify/WooCommerce integration page documenting which order fields (order history, status, refunds) appear in the inbox?

defining_need_fit.caveat: The selected evidence supports a website chat widget, an omnichannel inbox, analysis of conversations in one tool and a flat price for up to 20 users, but access to "customer histories" is documented via Decathlon's API and integrations rather than as Shopify/WooCommerce order data, and the flat plan carries no published amount.
defining_need_fit.why: Chat plus a single omnichannel inbox at a non-per-seat price is supported, while the order-history component of the stated conjunction is not established by the selected evidence.

first_email_scope.request: Write exactly one email. Introduce our product to a new buyer with one clear next step.
first_email_scope.workflow: Introduce Crisp as a website chat widget plus one omnichannel support inbox and invite the buyer to run it on their own site during the 14-day free trial, which includes all Crisp features and requires no card, as the single next step.

The buyer must install the Crisp chat widget on their site to run chat and the inbox
excluded_promises: Any claim that Shopify or WooCommerce order history is consolidated into the inbox
Any savings figure or superiority claim versus Intercom, Zendesk or Tidio
Any promise of zero disruption when migrating from an incumbent helpdesk

Any specific monthly price for the flat-price plan
